summary: Aura Minerals filed a Form 6-K furnishing its Third Quarter 2026 earnings presentation (Exhibit 99.1, dated November 6, 2026), the US-equivalent of a foreign private issuer's quarterly results disclosure. Highlights include record Q3 production of 96k GEO (up 27% QoQ), 9M production of 253k GEO against 340k-390k full-year guidance, record net revenues of US$386M at a US$4,202/oz gold price, adjusted EBITDA of US$237M, Q3 AISC of US$1,953/GEO (US$1,673 ex-MSG) and recurring free cash flow of US$124M. No transaction, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed; watch dividend and buyback commentary.
